meta.spec: docs/memory-spec.md §10.3 (anti-conflict), §5.4 (validity window), acceptance §13 row 14; ADR-007, R-CORE-3, R-MEM-5
meta.note: When a new fact contradicts an ACTIVE fact, consolidation must NEVER overwrite in place: it sets valid_to=now + status:superseded on the old block, appends a new block with valid_from=now + status:active, and writes a `supersede` L2 record linking old->new. The judge gate sees the conflicting active facts and must approve the supersede. Input state is the core.md fixture (fact_0009 active 'timezone UTC+9').

cases.case: §10.3 — judge rejects the supersede -> no change, rejection recorded
§10.3 — retrieval surfaces only ACTIVE facts (one value per fact at any time)
cases.note: With core.md as input, 'timezone' queries must return fact_0009 (active, UTC+9) and NOT fact_0007 (superseded) by default; include_expired:true may surface superseded/expired facts.
